svg.title: FIMViz.js object model — classes, members, and operations
svg.desc: A UML class diagram of the engine's public object model. FimViz creates a FimVizInstance, which owns FimMaps and a Dataset registry. A Dataset is an immutable description of a source and the operations asked of it; its derivation operations return new Datasets and its resolution operations return a RasterGrid, VectorFeatures or Stats. A Layer is one rendering of one or more Datasets, specialized as raster, vector, comparison and ensemble layers, and reads its presentation from ColorScale, Legend, Stats and Filter.
svg.text: a separate file, an in-file slice, or named variants
slope · select · reduce // to the sources
scopes a statistic or a metric
every derivation returns a new Dataset
composition — the owner's lifetime governs the part
Class names in italic are abstract. Multiplicity is carried on the attribute where an attribute already declares it, and on the line where it does not.
A source is not a rendering.
A Dataset describes where data comes from and what has been asked of it; a Layer is one way of drawing one or more Datasets. The cardinality runs both ways: one Dataset
backs many Layers, and the comparison and ensemble layers take several Datasets onto a common grid. A multi-dimensional source needs no class of its own: an Axis entry
addresses either a separate file or a slice of the one already held, and a selected step is an ordinary Dataset that any RasterLayer can draw.
